# Chulapa Jekyll theme

> Chulapa is a responsive Jekyll theme for blogs, portfolios, documentation and project sites. It uses Bootstrap and supports GitHub Pages and other Jekyll hosts.

The documentation is the source of truth for installation, configuration, layouts and supported integrations. Configure the site in `_config.yml` and use page front matter or Jekyll defaults for page options. Extend the theme through existing layouts, includes and assets.

The documentation also covers development changes after v2.1.0. Mermaid diagrams and the accessibility and resource-loading improvements are not included in the v2.1.0 gem or pinned remote theme. Check each page's version caveats and the theme version used by the site before applying its advice. Some integrations require third-party services, and accessibility depends on the site's content, skin and customizations as well as the theme.

## Getting started

- [Documentation overview](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs): Main documentation index.
- [Start a site](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/00-start): The Chulapa 101 personal-blog template and minimal blog, technical-blog, portfolio and project examples.
- [Installation](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/01-install): GitHub template, remote-theme and gem-based installation, dependencies and deployment guidance.
- [Global settings](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/02-config): Site metadata, navigation, search, comments, collections and Jekyll defaults.

## Theme and content reference

- [Theming](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/03-theming): Skins, fonts, syntax highlighting, Autothemer and Sass variable overrides.
- [Layouts and snippets](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/04-layouts): Layouts, page options, headers, TOCs, galleries, media, MathJax and Mermaid diagrams.
- [Variables dictionary](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/variable-dictionary): Sass variables configured under `chulapa-skin.vars`, rather than page front matter.
- [Markdown cheatsheet](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/markdown-cheatsheet): Markdown and kramdown syntax, tables, code and TOCs.
- [Syntax highlighting](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/syntax-highlighting): Rendered examples for supported code languages.

## Troubleshooting and site checks

- [Frequently asked questions](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/05-faq): Common setup and customization questions.
- [Accessibility and performance](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/docs/06-accessibility-performance): Keyboard navigation, visible focus, reduced motion, contrast and resource-loading advice, with development-version caveats.

## Optional

- [Chulapa v2.1.0 overview](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/blog/20261009_chulapa-v2-1-0): Released features, configuration examples and upgrade steps, with a separately labeled development preview.
- [Demos](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/demo): Working examples of layouts and integrations.
- [Skins](https://dieghernan.github.io/chulapa/skins): Skin previews and available choices.
- [Chulapa 101](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa-101): Editable personal-blog template with GitHub Pages publishing workflows.
- [Minimal example sources](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa/tree/main/examples): Source files for the four starter examples.
- [Documentation sources](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa/tree/main/docs/collections/_docs): Markdown sources for the documentation pages.
- [Theme source](https://github.com/dieghernan/chulapa): Theme implementation and development history.
